misc: Struggles with his gender identity, occasionally participating in events under his female alter-ego, "Eva".
biography: Marcus occupies a truly unprecedented and legendary position within the extensive chronicles of the Hector Trophée, having left an unbroken record of participation across all 13 distinct editions of the esteemed pair competition since its inception. Representing the immaculate fairways of Kurk Golf, this remarkable competitor brings an extraordinary level of dedication to the links, anchoring his status as an indispensable pillar of the tournament community where he remains fully active to this day.

Beyond his astonishing longevity on the course, Marcus is celebrated among his peers for a deeply introspective and complex personality that adds a fascinating layer of human depth to the event. Privately navigating his own profound journey with gender identity, Marcus occasionally embraces his female alter-ego, Eva, during tournament activities, showcasing a courageous authenticity that deeply inspires everyone fortunate enough to share the fairways with her and him.

While victories of the coveted Hector Trophée and the individual acclaim of the Victor Trophy have thus far eluded Marcus across his remarkable thirteen appearances, the pursuit of ultimate glory remains fiercely alive. Observers and fellow golfers continuously watch with immense admiration, knowing that whenever Marcus steps up to the tee, history is unfolding in real-time through the actions of one of the tournament's most enduring and fascinating legends.
